requirement_text: If the configuration needs to be changed due to a fault, as specified above, Redundancy Management shall issue a configuration update to mask out the failed network element.
requirement_text_raw: If the configuration needs to be changed due to a fault, as specified above, Redundancy Management shall [SRS128] issue a configuration update to mask out the failed network element.

acceptance_criteria: Given a fault that requires a configuration change, when Redundancy Management reacts, then it issues a configuration update.

requirement_text: The administer is presented with two lists of NDC codes or names.

user_story: As a public health agent, I want to remove an adverse event report, for example after talking to the reporter or when it looks bogus, so that bad reports are cleared.

acceptance_criteria: Given an adverse event report, when the public health agent removes it, then the report is no longer listed.
Given a removed report, when the report list is viewed, then it is not shown.

requirement_text: The operating temperature range for the prototype NEs shall be from 0 to 32.2º C at the inlet to the cooling fans.
requirement_text_raw: The operating temperature range for the prototype NEs shall (3.2.3.1.1.3) be from 0 to 32.2º C at the inlet to the cooling fans.

user_story: As a user, I want to switch the web portal's language to Spanish, so that I can read it in Spanish.

acceptance_criteria: Given the web portal, when the user selects Spanish, then the portal is displayed in Spanish.
Given the portal in Spanish, when the user opens another page, then it is also in Spanish.

requirement_text: The system shall prevent producing any audible disturbance signals independently from opened / closed state of sun roofs, doors and windows.
user_story: As a driver, I want no audible disturbance signals regardless of whether sun roofs, doors and windows are open or closed, so that the cabin stays quiet.
technical_task: Prevent audible disturbance signals in every open or closed state of sun roofs, doors and windows.
acceptance_criteria: Given sun roofs, doors and windows are open, when the system runs, then no audible disturbance signal is produced.
Given sun roofs, doors and windows are closed, when the system runs, then no audible disturbance signal is produced.

requirement_text: A list of all disputes cases that meet the entered search criteria must be provided to the user.
